authority: The user-designated release is authoritative and read only. Validity, D1 status masking, window grouping and tie order are imported unchanged from the accepted 02 and 03 scripts. The governing design is the observed-assessment amendment, which authorises no clinical fact.

baseline_reconciliation.historical_inventory_status: Superseded row-based inventory retained as historical accounting only. It is not an adjudicated exposure and is not used for any grouping here.

context_provenance_note: Only accepted, settled context is bound by hash. The concurrently owned covariate EDA record is not bound, so its expected rebuilds cannot fail this verification for reasons unrelated to this derivation.

definitions.availability: Record availability among observed care, not a response probability among eligible patients.
definitions.burden: Four-level documentary category from every status-consistent record on the selected early day. Independent bound fallbacks, no interval intersection, no event index and no later outcome participate. Devices never supply ordinary-pad quantities.
definitions.nonconflicting_quantity_uncertain: Compatible or all-missing evidence, including a crossing range beside a precise record. Missing rows never veto a compatible known category.
definitions.policies: P1 window restriction, P2 first usable day, P3 narrow windows, P4 date-impact exclusion including nonselected uncertain dates, P5 released milestone rule. Each rebuilds the full robotic cohort. Differences combine measurement and population change.
definitions.selection: Nearest target day inside the window, ties to the earlier day, then released event index. A patient-day holding both explicit states is unavailable; P0 permits another consistent day in the same window and flags the re-entry.
definitions.status: Explicit Boolean pad status only, after the accepted D1 endpoint and device mask.
definitions.units: Patients, observation rows and patient-day groups are distinct and are never summed together.
definitions.unknown: Unknown country or age remains unknown. Nothing is recoded and nothing is imputed.
definitions.unresolved_quantity_evidence: Invalid selected-day quantity evidence or valid intervals with an empty intersection, including disjoint exact counts.

gates.label: Three burden indicators, age and country.
Main structure plus early-day and year-day timing.

feasibility_count_gates.meaning: Count adequacy and covariate structure only. No fit, probability, interval or test is produced.
feasibility_count_gates.structural_support_scope: Preliminary structural support only: recomputed arm counts, complete outcome-by-burden cells, country support and covariate rank on each model's own eligible rows. Covariate overlap, functional form, separation, influence and leave-one-patient-out stability are assessed separately and afterwards, and a supported structure remains unfitted here.
feasibility_count_gates.superseded_three_level_note: The current structure is the four-level documentary burden with five and seven slope degrees of freedom. The earlier three-level four and six slope screening is superseded for this target.

limitations: Derivation only. No probability, confidence interval, hypothesis test, model fit or bound on real data.
The opportunity-conditioned original primary remains held because administrative eligibility A is unknown.
Selected assessments describe documented care. They do not establish the true state on any day.
Policy differences are not confidence bounds, identification bounds or a range of clinical truth.
Count gates describe adequacy under the amendment rule. They license no model and no claim.
The superseded row-based burden inventory is historical accounting only.

four_level_burden.meaning: Declared documentary exposure on the selected early day. Not an adjudicated clinical quantity and not a resolution of any contradictory record.

record_availability.meaning: Documented record availability among observed care. Not an opportunity-conditioned response fraction, not a weight and not a missing-outcome bound.

P5.milestone_note: Released milestone observation rule. No exact-window early burden is borrowed and no day is selected.

scope: Documented assessment selection, four-level documentary burden and named policy rebuilds. No probability, interval, hypothesis test, model fit, weight, imputation or bound on real data.
